name: Ugin's ally
aliases: winged creature with a man's bearded face and a big cat's paws
description: A winged sphinx-like creature in a city of glass and stone who agrees to help Ugin trap Bolas.

timeline.summary: Memory: Ugin asks a winged ally in a glass city for help to trap Bolas, planning to lure him to Tarkir.
timeline.quote: I will lure him to Tarkir.

relations.note: the winged ally agrees to help trap Bolas
relations.quote: Ugin, my friend, welcome to my newest home.

pages_say.description: A winged sphinx-like creature in a city of glass and stone who agrees to help Ugin trap Bolas.
